children.text: Mage/Melee should be limited to only free(sc) or hammer roles as well as only 1 per team for optimal performance. It provides strong damage for p1-3 and zaros but woll not attack minions p3 and severely lacks pillar damage.
at 6 seconds on the boss timer
should be cast 1 tick before amalgamations spawn, can also optionally stall
